Owns roadmaps, PRDs and the KPI stack from activation to LTV. ## Experience

- **Ekatra Collective**, Product and Revenue Strategy (consulting), Jaipur, Feb 2026 to present. Scaled a B2B gifting platform supplying teams at Google, Microsoft, Netflix and Salesforce; introduced AI-powered internal platforms and agentic workflows; converted the first US enterprise account.
- **OptiServ Consulting**, Product and Customer Experience Manager, Hyderabad, Dec 2025 to Feb 2026. Owned roadmap and KPI framework for a customer experience platform; repeat usage +15%, CSAT +9%, response time −27%; led a 25-member cross-functional team.
- **KPAX Marketing**, Head of Growth and Product, Cyprus (remote), Oct 2021 to Nov 2025. Led the 0 to 1 launch of a gaming platform; App Store category rank #180 to #1; registration-to-deposit +20%; LTV $70 to $350; scaled to $2.5 to 3.5M annual net revenue.
- **Ekatra Collective**, GTM and Product Marketing Manager, Jaipur, Dec 2020 to Oct 2021. Post Shark Tank go-to-market; revenue from $50K to $2M; stood up corporate gifting as a product line.
- **ThinkQuant**, Growth and Product Associate, Gurgaon, Feb 2019 to Nov 2020. Launched a multi-channel lifecycle CRM product on MoEngage; monthly signups +57%.

## Projects and systems built

- **Ekatra Invoice Tracker:** reads invoice PDFs dropped in WhatsApp with OCR, verifies amounts, stores them, shows a live receivables dashboard and sends automated reminders and digests. Cloudflare Pages, D1, R2, a WhatsApp agent and the Gmail API. Runs for about ₹470 a month.
- **Ekatra HR System:** attendance from biometric exports, leave, overtime, payroll preview and sales incentives with a tested rule engine and role-based access.
- **DispatchOps:** B2B dispatch tracking with courier sticker OCR, 12 shipment states and e-way bill checks, on Supabase.
- **Karmic AI:** AI-first consumer mobile app on React Native, Expo and the Claude API with memory, retrieval and background workflows.
- **AlphaPulse:** rule-based algorithmic trading engine with backtesting and risk controls.

## Answers (short, data-backed)

- [What does it cost to automate invoice follow-ups for an Indian SMB?](https://vaibhavvijay.com/answers/cost-to-automate-invoice-follow-ups-india): About ₹470 a month. That is the running cost of the invoice tracker I built for Ekatra: one small server for the WhatsApp agent, with the web app, database, storage, schedules and email on free tiers.
- [How do you stop OCR from misreading invoice amounts?](https://vaibhavvijay.com/answers/verify-ocr-invoice-amounts): Read the amount twice: once from the figures and once from the amount-in-words line that Indian invoices carry, and accept the invoice only when both agree. Mismatches go to a person, and their correction is locked so the next scan can't overwrite it.
- [How did Apple Search Ads and ASO take an app from #180 to #1?](https://vaibhavvijay.com/answers/apple-search-ads-app-store-rank-180-to-1): By running App Store Optimization and Apple Search Ads as one system: paid keyword and creative tests decided what went into the organic listing. In about 90 days the app moved from #180 to #1 in its category, with organic installs up 80 to 120% and blended CAC down 15 to 25%.
- [How do you raise customer LTV from $70 to $350?](https://vaibhavvijay.com/answers/raise-ltv-70-to-350-deposit-tiers): Segment customers by deposit tier, give each tier its own journey and triggers, and price bonuses by cohort instead of handing them out evenly. On a real-money gaming platform this took LTV from $70 to $350 and cut payback from five months to three.
- [How do you lift sign-up to first deposit conversion in an Indian app?](https://vaibhavvijay.com/answers/improve-signup-to-first-deposit-conversion): Fix the two places people drop: identity checks and the first payment. Clearer KYC guidance, offer and landing page tests and social proof took registration-to-deposit from 5% to 6%, and smarter routing across UPI, IMPS and cards raised deposit acceptance by 5 to 8 points.
- [How did Ekatra grow from $50K to $2M in revenue after Shark Tank India?](https://vaibhavvijay.com/answers/ekatra-shark-tank-50k-to-2m): By turning the attention into a repeatable go-to-market: sharper positioning and packaging, a demand engine across Meta, Google, influencers and WhatsApp CRM, and corporate gifting as a new product line. Revenue grew from $50K to $2M.
